summary: RPG Effect All Free by unknown author: 273 files (64.8 MB) — 273 images (10 pixel-art, mostly >512 px, 16 animation sequences).

content.description: 273 pixel-art visual-effect sheets (roughly 512-1088 px) packed as sprite strips: rows of animation frames in many colour tints. Effects include glowing orbs, sparks, stars, slashes, rings, bubbles, smoke puffs, fireballs, magic circles, healing/impact bursts and directional projectiles. Black backgrounds with additive-style bright pixels. Intended for spell, hit and pickup animations in top-down or side-view games; slice the rows into frames per effect.
